Definition: from G1537 and a derivative of G5087; put out, i.e. exposed to perish:--cast out.
BiblicalUsage: ékthetos means cast out. In Acts 7:19, the text says "so that they cast out their young children."
TheologicalSignificance: I take ékthetos as it stands: cast out.
